items.title: Live: Nifty off day's low, reclaims 23,100; ESDS hit 5% lower circuit | Closing Bell
items.description: Markets are off the day’s lows, with the Nifty rebounding 80 points from the low and reclaiming the 23,100 mark, while the Sensex has recovered over 250 points from the day’s low. However, markets remain set to clock their seventh straight weekly loss, with uncertainty around US-Iran talks continuing to weigh on sentiment. Banks, metal and realty stocks are seeing buying interest, while IT and pharma stocks lag behind. Broader markets are mixed, with smallcaps trading in the green. Market breadth remains neutral, while the VIX declines 3%. Among Nifty 50 stocks, Axis Bank, M&M and Asian Paints are the top gainers, while Max Healthcare, Tata Motors PV and Infosys are the top losers.

items.title: Centre Point: Commission Cap Puts Insurance Under Scanner
items.description: Centre Point, hosted by Surabhi Upadhyay, breaks down IRDAI's proposed overhaul of how insurance is sold in India. The regulator is looking to cap insurance commissions, which currently run as high as 80-90% of premium value in some policies, while also cracking down on the compulsory sale of insurance with loans and on "dark patterns" used by online insurance sellers to extract personal information before disclosing policy features and pricing. The proposal triggered a sharp selloff in financial stocks on Thursday, hitting insurers, banks, and NBFCs that earn a significant share of their income from insurance commissions and fees. With industry stakeholders given time till October 25 to submit their views, the show examines the road ahead: how mis-selling and malpractices can be curbed without destabilising insurers, and whether the industry can find a path to growth that also rebuilds consumer trust. Joining the discussion are Nilesh Sathe, former Member of IRDAI; Ashish Modani, Senior Vice President and Group Head - Financial Ratings, ICRA Ltd; and Indraneel Chatterjee, COO and Co-Founder, Insurance Dekho.
